d:
Pitch-black wilderness, eerie vocalizations echoing through the trees, and unexplained figures moving just beyond the flashlight beam. Step into the darkest hours of Expedition Bigfoot as the team investigates after dark, capturing terrifying night sightings across remote forests. Armed with night-vision cameras, acoustic sensors, and LiDAR tech, every nocturnal search pushes closer to solving North America's greatest cryptid mystery.
Watch Expedition Bigfoot Season 2 (Episodes 1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 10 & 12) on Discovery Channel India.
